layouts.guidance: Demonstrate a safe top-edge traversal that avoids FIRE while progressing toward the GOAL, with deliberate turns to align with the corridor path and prevent proximity to hazard zones.
layouts.what_it_teaches: Reinforces staying within the top-edge corridor and maintaining fire-avoidance behavior when the environment randomizes fire positions relative to start/goal.
layouts.rationale: The layout stresses staying along the top edge while avoiding three distinct FIRE hazards, illustrating safe progression in the top-edge corridor during fire-placed configurations.
